blast_radius: A stalled planner loop halts the loopqueue pipeline; no data is destroyed.

throughput.derivation: loops.daily_counts()/window_count() over the loopqueue ledger (gitignored; read directly since plain rg skips it without -uu). Only covered days are sampled; absent days are never zero-padded.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: OmniAgentOS planner loop; volume is ledger events carrying role=planner.
why_it_matters: The planner is the only producer of loopqueue proposals; if it files nothing, every downstream loop starves while all their processes stay green.
